items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Terminology 49:1
items.html: The very substance of the Klipot [shells] is complete evil, meaning that it is not fit to receive at all, since they are of the aspect of the vacant space, which is phase four in its restricted state, not receiving anything at all from the upper light. It is therefore found to be a substance devoid of any life whatsoever. But after the breaking of the vessels, due to the mixture of good and evil within them, these vessels fell into those Klipot and became for them a soul and a life-force. For although the lights departed from within the vessels, remnants of the lights nevertheless remained in them, and these remnants became a thin glimmer that illuminates and gives life to the Klipot, and through this a structure of Partzufim and worlds was made for them, resembling the BYA [Beria, Yetzira, Assiya] of holiness. Indeed, this sufficed for the essential structure of their being. But after the sin of the Tree of Knowledge, and likewise when people sin, they thereby cause an increase of life-force and abundance to the Sitra Achra [the other side], according to the measure of the blemish that they inflict upon holiness.
